name: jupyter-cells
author: lumine-code
description: Navigate, run, and organize code cells marked with # %% comments.
backgroundTips: {% if keys['jupyter-cells:run-cell'] %}You can run the whole # %% cell around the cursor with {{ 'jupyter-cells:run-cell' | keystroke }}{% else %}You can split a plain source file into runnable cells with # %% comment markers.{% endif %}

cellMarkers.title: Cell Markers
cellMarkers.description: Draw a boundary line on every cell marker row. The line can be customised in your `styles.css`.

codeLenses.title: Code Lenses
codeLenses.description: Show Run Cell and Run All Above links above each cell marker. Needs the code-lens package, and jupyter-repl to run anything. Also settable per language in scoped settings.

importNotebookURI.title: Enable notebook auto-import
importNotebookURI.description: If enabled, opening a file with extension `.ipynb` will import the notebook file's source into a new tab. If disabled, or if the jupyter-cells package is not activated, the raw file will open in Lumine as normal.

importNotebookResults.title: Enable import of notebook results
importNotebookResults.description: If enabled, anytime you import a notebook, the saved results are also rendered inline. Needs the jupyter-repl package. If disabled, you can still import notebooks as normal.
